78562.subject: 🔷 The Daily: AMC stock jumps as its CEO blasts Robinhood's tokenized shares
78562.body:
US bitcoin ETFs report the largest inflow day since January, worth $731 million | Trezor says ShipMonk breach affected another 67,000 customers | South Korea to start tokenizing securities in three stages from 2027 | El Salvador has not used public funds to accumulate bitcoin since June 2025, IMF says |

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by James Hunt | Edited by Jason Shubnell

Presented By:

( https://thezcashetf.com/?utm_campaign=website-traffic-zcsh-newsletters--2026-08-25&utm_medium=paid-other&utm_source=the-block&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Friday 🎉 *Bitcoin* dipped back below $80,000 after a stronger-than-expected *U.S. jobs report* pushed rate-hike odds higher. *21Shares* ' *Matt Mena* is eyeing a recovery toward $82,000, while *Bitget Research's Ryan Lee* said holding above $78,000 through next week would indicate the rate move has been priced in.

In today's newsletter, *AMC* CEO *Adam Aron* hits out at *Robinhood's* *tokenized stocks* , *bitcoin ETFs* see their largest daily inflows since January, *Trezor* says the *ShipMonk* data breach affected another 67,000 of its customers, and more.

Meanwhile, *Zcash* tops $1,000 ( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-09-04-zcash-tops-1000-etf-inflows-ramp-up-miners-pile-in-413580?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) as ETF inflows ramp up and miners pile in.

*P.S.* Don't forget to check out today's reader poll on *bitcoin's reaction to the jobs report* later in the newsletter.

*THE BIG ONE*

*👀 AMC CEO slams Robinhood over 'outrageous' tokenized shares*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-09-04-amc-ceo-slams-robinhood-413513?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*AMC* CEO *Adam Aron* blasted *Robinhood* for tokenizing U.S. stocks, calling the practice "outrageous" and questioning how it could be legal.

* Aron said AMC has no connection to the tokens offering exposure to its stock and will ask its outside securities counsel to review the matter.
* Robinhood CEO *Vlad Tenev* fired back with a terse "What's the concern?" while the company's own docs describe the tokens as debt securities issued by an offshore affiliate that carry no ownership or shareholder rights.
* The fintech giant stipulates that tokenized stocks have not been registered as securities in the U.S. and may not be offered in the country.
* AMC's stock jumped nearly 21% in overnight trading to $3.07 amid the spat. AMC is currently up 5.3% in the regular Friday session.
* It echoes a similar 2025 clash when *OpenAI* disowned Robinhood's tokens tied to it, with Tenev arguing then that they're derivatives, not equity, and shouldn't need a company's opt-in.
* Tokenized stocks have surged in recent months, with total market cap hitting $13.4 billion as of Sept. 1, up from $2.5 b

Hi Oleg,

The smart money in AI video just made a statement.

Higgsfield (https://dxszHp04.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DR+113/dxszHp04/VX5Zh08yvW67W1ntqvb7-_f1zW4lQ0X35TxYRmN1c6srn3pyd0W8wLKSR6lZ3lzW5pQ5Pp4tKSLBW2GXl9P3tRZbwW7RmSLr28jzTsW2D_kCF1S_dMZW1syhFy2v_NnMW2qwtBR1zrr29N37v3F47XFHtW2cdbF-6kCMZwW4Yw3cv7cLbYHW5KxlD04wxLmWW8YW7HR3rhf9lMbsr8cWbrnSW4VsFv31QhJkgW9cWNh22WKnL3W8z00t_8k7kZTW6Ndssq8-xDg8W7tqnZV2fhlG5W7jNVr18BDM8fW8l_7p03RsqvDW8w3B7J6BrZcMW1c_vbn4C5-zNW8nkzYZ5jTKdtW59jn9m6g6V_jVCqcBT7ZY9VdW8k_NKX7Ryr-zVzmQbt8dgtb6N15r5L4gfH3wW6fM7tt2Lt5Nkd1SjzH04 ) raised a $400 million Series B led by DST Global at an estimated $5.4 billion valuation,¹ more than quadruple its value from the company’s previous round.²

DST was joined by investors like Goldman Sachs, Accel, Menlo Ventures, Intel Capital, Tribe Capital, and Smash Capital; Smash was co-founded by former Disney exec Kevin Mayer.¹

According to Mayer, “Higgsfield is empowering storytellers to push past the limits of traditional production, laying the groundwork for a new era of human creativity.”¹

Boris Revsin of Tribe Capital added that “Higgsfield’s revenue velocity and customer retention speak for themselves.”¹ Here’s a look at some of those numbers:

- $700 million in annualized revenue reached in August.¹
- Agentic-product users up 42x in just three months.¹
- 390 of the Fortune 500 trust Higgsfield, with 30M+ users in 238 countries.¹

There’s no guarantee that revenue, funding, or valuation will continue to grow for Higgsfield, or that the company will be profitable. See the risk disclosures on the offering page.

With Series Higgsfield-QP-1 (https://dxszHp04.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DR+113/dxszHp04/VX5Zh08yvW67W1ntqvb7-_f1zW4lQ0X35TxYRmN1c6srn3pyd0W8wLKSR6lZ3lzW5pQ5Pp4tKSLBW2GXl9P3tRZbwW7RmSLr28jzTsW2D_kCF1S_dMZW1syhFy2v_NnMW2qwtBR1zrr29N37v3F47XFHtW2cdbF-6kCMZwW4Yw3cv7cLbYHW5KxlD04wxLmWW8YW7HR3rhf9lMbsr8cWbrnSW4VsFv31QhJkgW9cWNh22WKnL3W8z00t_8k7kZTW6Ndssq8-xDg8W7tqnZV2fhlG5W7jNVr18BDM8fW8l_7p03RsqvDW8w3B7J6BrZcMW1c_vbn4C5-zNW8nkzYZ5jTKdtW59jn9m6g6V_jVCqcBT7ZY9VdW8k_NKX7Ryr-zVzmQbt8dgtb6N15r5L4gfH3wW6fM7tt2Lt5Nkd1SjzH04 ) , we’ve provided qualified purchasers with exposure to a fast-scaling AI video company backed by some of tech’s most established investors.
